Hi, I'm a paralegal coordinator at a small law firm. We just had a phone intake with a new client (Lin, case ref: 2024-01-15) and our junior assistant took down some raw, messy notes — the file is at `case-files/incoming/lin_intake_raw_notes_20240115.txt`. The notes are unorganized and incomplete, but the senior partner needs a clean structured intake summary before tomorrow morning so she can decide whether to take the case.

Please process those raw notes and produce a proper intake summary saved as `lin_intake_summary.md`. The summary needs to be ready for the partner to review — organized, professional, and clearly flagging anything we don't yet know or need to follow up on. Note that the client mentioned some health-related background, so please handle that sensitively.

Important: the partner specifically said she does NOT want any legal opinions or conclusions in the summary — just the facts, the gaps, and the open questions.
